content.text:
This Outlook Scheduling Assistant screenshot shows the free/busy times of six attendees and the room NYC-12 Hudson (8) on Monday and Tuesday (all times New York time). I need to book a 60-minute meeting. Rules: Priya Shah and Marcus Lee are required; at least 2 of the other four (Elena Ruiz, Kenji Watanabe, Grace Liu and Jamal Wright) must also be able to attend; tentative (hatched) blocks count as free, while busy and out-of-office blocks count as busy; the meeting must not overlap the 12:00-13:00 lunch hour; the room row must be free for the whole meeting; the meeting must lie within 9:00-17:00 and start on a quarter hour. What is the earliest start time that satisfies every rule? Answer as the day and the 24-hour start time, in the form `Tue 09:45` (three-letter day, HH:MM with a leading zero).

Think step by step. Then end your reply with one final line in exactly this form:
FINAL ANSWER: <your answer>

message.content:
**Monday (Nov 16):** Priya and Marcus share free time only in 10:30-11:45, 13:30-14:00, 15:00-15:30 and 16:00-17:00.
- 10:30-11:30 is blocked because the room is busy (Exec staff) until 11:15.
- Any start from 11:15 runs into lunch.
- 13:30-14:00 and 15:00-15:30 are only 30 minutes.
- 16:00-17:00 has only Jamal free. Elena (Standup from 16:45), Kenji (Training to 17:15) and Grace (busy from 16:30) are all unavailable.

Monday has no valid slot.

**Tuesday (Nov 17):**
- Marcus is free 9:15-10:45, 11:15-12:00 and 13:45-17:00 (tentative blocks count as free).
- Priya is free 9:45-13:15 (tentative 11:00-11:30 counts as free), 14:15-14:45 and 15:15-16:15.
- Priya and Marcus together are free at 9:45-10:45, 11:15-12:00 (too short because of lunch), 14:15-14:45 (too short) and 15:15-16:15.
- **9:45-10:45:** The room is free (Recruiting ends at 9:45). Elena is busy from 10:30, Kenji from 10:15, Grace from 10:30 and Jamal until 10:00. Nobody is free for two of the four, so this fails.
- **15:15-16:15:** The room is free (busy 14:15-15:00, next block 16:30). Priya and Marcus are both free. Grace is free (her 15:30-16:30 block is tentative). Jamal is free (his next block starts 16:45). Elena (busy 15:30-16:00) and Kenji (busy 15:00-16:00) are unavailable, but Grace and Jamal satisfy the two-of-four rule.

The earliest valid slot is Tuesday 15:15.

FINAL ANSWER: Tue 15:15
